body:
The heat-loss learners absorb solar-aperture error. The replay nets the modelled
solar term out only to the accuracy of the aperture, and solar gain correlates
with the conductive term through the time of day and the outdoor temperature.
So a mis-set aperture leaves a residual that the Newton step settles into the
heat-loss coefficient, at a value that looks converged (D2-s3-71). Closes #2223,
the class `N-confounded-learner`.

**What changed.** Three residual-fed folds and the drift refit share one dark
gauge, `HEAT_LOSS_MAX_SOLAR_W_M2`. It is the threshold `_fold_internal_gains`
already used, as the RCA instructed.

- `_async_learn_house_heat_loss` and `_async_learn_lower_floor_loss` return
  before their Newton steps on a sunlit interval.
  - The house fold's gate sits after the open-window CUSUM feed and after
    `_fold_solar_aperture`. So the detector still sees the day (#2241's carry),
    and the aperture learner keeps the daylight.
- `accuracy.heat_loss_refit` records the interval's irradiance on
  `AccuracySample` and refuses a sunlit pair.
  - The field is declared in `store.DOMAINS`, so `finite_boundary` drives it.
  - A sample with no recorded sun reads as dark, which is the tree's rule for
    an unknown irradiance.
- `_fold_internal_gains` folds only once the heat-loss walk has converged:
  `house_loss_confidence` >= `INTERNAL_GAINS_MIN_UA_CONFIDENCE`.
  - One residual feeds both learners, so an unidentified level would otherwise
    be learned as an hour shape.
  - The RCA's two other shapes are measured under `## Figures`.

The folds spelled out the zone-temperature and zone-capacity choices
separately; each now answers from one pure helper. The house fold's two dt
guards are one range check. Together these pay the coordinator's zero headroom.

A features check now drives the coordinator's own path for the refit's
irradiance record: the prediction capture, then the settle into
`_accuracy`. The round-2 fix review (comment 6325893059) found that both
plumbing lines survived the whole scoped gate.

The body was re-cut at round 4 (`fixer.md`, "Past three rounds"). This round
re-takes only what its change and its merge of `origin/main` reach; `## Head`
says which figures those are.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_011T53hYMqChYZy7Y7jzuTEu

## Head

`4276bf8e7b5f769b5595f35232161ed963501961` merges main `3976515` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`d48018b80be11a2029e8492590a1a9e4b3a2eae9` merges the authored code head `d717b51486bf78df2e18b7bd3bdaf34abc23cc9b` and then merges origin/main `1ebc737e7` (an automatic merge by the orchestrator's script; any resolution inside the code head is described below) into this PR's previous head.

`d717b51486bf78df2e18b7bd3bdaf34abc23cc9b`.

It is the PR head `2f47581094ad66bd76ccfa6efff92aef90036aeb` plus two commits,
with no rebase:
- `5860e02e4`, the new features check (`tests/features.py` only);
- a merge of `origin/main` at `1ebc737e7`.

The merge reaches no production code, harness or role contract.
`git diff --name-only 57f0c9c77 1ebc737e7 | grep -E '^custom_components|^tests/features|^dev/governance/roles'`
exits 1, printing nothing. So the harness, companion, enumerator, alternatives
and carry-control figures under `## Figures` stand as taken at `9f0ed12e7`.
The PR head's tree `df75d6ebc` is the same as that commit's, and the fix review
re-derived every one of those figures at `2f4758109`.

Re-taken at this head: the mutation proof, the scoped gate, structure, the
architecture score and the carry audit. Measured on 2026-10-21 (UTC) with
`origin/main` at `1ebc737e7`. Python is `/opt/hpo/venv-ci`.
`git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD` exits 0.

## Mutation proof

The two plumbing mutants were each applied alone, in a detached `git worktree`
at `5860e02e4`. `git diff --quiet 5860e02e4 HEAD -- custom_components tests/features.py`
exits 0, so that is this head's production code and check file. Each run was
`PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/features.py`, and the worktrees were then
discarded.

| site | mutant | failing checks | run |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coordinator.py:9796`, the pending capture in `_record_accuracy` | `"solar": ctx._current_state.solar_radiation` -> `"solar": None` | `#2223: the coordinator's sunlit prediction settles with its sun, and the refit refuses it` | `1 of 4290 FEATURE CHECKS FAILED`, rc=1 |
| `coordinator.py:9718`, the settled `AccuracySample` | `solar_radiation=pending.get("solar")` -> `solar_radiation=None` | that check, and `#2223: an accuracy sample records the sun its prediction was made under` | `2 of 4290 FEATURE CHECKS FAILED`, rc=1 |
| `coordinator.py:9041 CMP_BOUND`, `_fold_internal_gains` (round 4) | `<` -> `<=` | `#2223: a heat-loss level exactly on the confidence threshold has converged` | `1 of 4289 FEATURE CHECKS FAILED`, rc=1 |

- **What the new check read under each plumbing mutant:**
  `sunlit: sun None pair (0.0, 23.0); dark: sun None pair (0.0, 23.0)`.
  - The stored sample lost the irradiance.
  - So `accuracy._refit_pair` admitted the sunlit pair as a dark one. That is
    the base behaviour #2223 closes.
- **How the new check works.** It runs `_record_accuracy` twice under
  `dt_util.freeze`:
  - first at 12:00 with `_current_state.solar_radiation = 640.0`, which captures
    the coordinator's own prediction;
  - then at 12:30 under a dark sky (`0.0`), which settles that prediction into
    `_accuracy`.
  - It asserts that the tracker's last sample carries 640.0 and that
    `_refit_pair` refuses it.
  - The settle reads a dark sky on purpose: a sample that took the sun at settle
    time rather than capture time also fails the check.
- The round-4 site's mutant was not re-run at this head. Its line and its
  check are unchanged.

`mutation-autofix` pinned the 9041 site in `ac4d62106`. The two plumbing sites
are values in a dict literal and a keyword argument. The ledger's mutant
classes do not generate those, so this table is their proof.

## Null control

- **The unmutated tree.** `tests/features.py` at this head printed
  `ALL 4290 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED` (rc=0), and the new check reads `ok`.
- **The new check's own control arm.** It is the same drive with a dark capture
  (`0.0`). The check asserts that this arm settles with `0.0` and forms a refit
  pair (`_refit_pair` not `None`).
  - So the sunlit arm's refusal is the sun's. It is not a sample the refit
    would refuse anyway.
  - Before the arm had a plan trajectory, the drive settled `predicted_temp=None`
    and both arms read `pair None`. The check failed on the dark arm, at the
    head, unmutated. This is the vacuity the control exists to catch, and it
    was repaired by setting `_mode = "auto"` and a plan trajectory before the
    capture.
- **The prior plumbing check** (`an accuracy sample records the sun its
  prediction was made under`) hands `_record_accuracy` a built `pending`. So it
  kills only the 9718 mutant and passes under the 9796 one, as the table shows.
- **That check's own control arm.** The `#2223` threshold check's drive at 113
  samples, one under the moved threshold, reads unformed at the head and under
  its mutant (round 4).
- **The flat-irradiance arm.** The aperture multiplies zero irradiance there,
  so `fixed_arm_spread` reads 0.0000 on P1..P5 (`.flat.g1.00`) at both ends.
- **The companion's dark arms read the same at both ends:**
  `house.dark.samples=8`, `lower.dark.samples=1`, `refit.dark.pairs=192`.
- **The companion's positive gains arm** reads `gains.converged.rel_dev=1.9800`
  at both ends. So the fix stops the confounded arm without stilling a learner
  it should leave alone.
- **The aperture learner.** P1 autumn `solar_scale.learn` reads 1.359 at both
  ends.
- **The no-window vent arms.** The 4 arms ending `.g1.0.ua1.0.vent0x0h` read
  `false_share=0.000` at both ends.

## Figures

## Architecture score

`python3 tools/audit/archscore/score.py --diff origin/main` prints
`Architecture score: dS +0.3110 IMPROVES`:

- `coord_footprint` 2494 -> 2493.

Both come from the two moved pure helpers. No metric rises.

## Alternatives

- **The RCA's two internal-gains shapes.** Both are measured under `## Figures`.
  Both fail.
- **A clock-based night window.** The confound is the measured solar term. A
  clock window would fold an overcast noon and skip a bright evening.
- **A gate only on `dt_h`.** It would not separate a sunlit interval from a dark
  one.
- **Moving the aperture fold above the max-residual guard.** That changes
  another learner's input.
- **A `survivor_triage` record for `coordinator.py:9041 CMP_BOUND`.** The mutant
  can be killed by moving the threshold onto a confidence the learner reaches.
  So a value check was taken instead of a triage.

## Red checks

The check runs at the PR head `2f47581094ad66bd76ccfa6efff92aef90036aeb` (all
concluded) list one failure. This head has not run in CI yet.
- **`nightly-status`.** It grades `main`'s latest scheduled `Tests` run,
  39563978649 (2026-10-21 07:43Z). Its failed jobs are `slow` and
  `mutation-nightly` (from that run's jobs API), so the red is main's, not this
  branch's. It is owned by main's nightly lanes, and this diff reaches no input
  those lanes read.
- `mutation` and `pr-contract`, red at `baa01ed85` in round 4, read success at
  `2f4758109`. That round's body answers them: the bot pin `ac4d62106`, and
  the body that routed the ΔT-part item.

## Unpinned sites

Round 4's `prepr.sh` step 6d listed the one site this diff adds:
`custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py:9041 CMP_BOUND`. This
round adds no production line. At this head,
`PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/pr/ci_predict.py --base origin/main`
prints `CI PREDICT: no closures or fast red predicted against 1ebc737e7e18`.
- It is killed by the value check `#2223: a heat-loss level exactly on the
  confidence threshold has converged` in `tests/features.py`.
- It is pinned by `mutation-autofix` in `ac4d62106`.

## Forward-carry

- **The D2 step-5 gains-arm precondition.** A probe of the internal-gains
  learner must run at a converged heat-loss level with a genuine gain, and the
  class barrier must drive the learners together.
  - Its control: `r10_night_folds_learners.py` `gains.converged.rel_dev` > 0.05
    with `gains.unconverged.rel_dev` 0.0000.
  - Carried to R10-BRIEFS-FOLD's `carry` list in
    `dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` on `handoff/audit-r10-roster`.
  - Verify with
    `git show origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json | grep -c "drive the learners together"`,
    which prints 1 with that ref at `23ef06dc6cc719917e593174b3a12977cd054071`.

  Carry: R10-BRIEFS-FOLD
- **The delivery-shortfall arms move** (Figures). They are the commanded-power
  replay confound, measured by the study's own dark arm at both ends.
  Carry: dismissed: measured not defect
- **The marginal 150 W/K x 4 h window loses one of twenty arms** (Figures). The
  detector is not this group's seam, and its 300 W/K control holds.
  Carry: dismissed: measured consequence in figures
- **The roster carry's owner-bundle instruction cannot be run here.** The
  bundle is owner data held outside the tree.
  Carry: dismissed: owner data outside tree
- **The sweep enumerator's `probe_internal_gains` now raises** (Figures). It is
  a round-10 measurement record, not a gate, and this fix removes its premise.
  Carry: dismissed: record harness, premise removed by the fix
- **The alternatives harness's ΔT-part line** (Figures) records a rejected
  design that was measured to fail. It is not an open defect.
  Carry: dismissed: rejected alternative measured in figures (item 1492c8f9)
- **The fix review's vacuous-test block** (comment 6325893059): the refit's
  irradiance record survived the scoped gate under the 9796 mutant. The new
  check under `## Mutation proof` kills both plumbing mutants at this head.
  Carry: dismissed: repaired at this head

## Friction

- fixer.md#2: unclear: step 2 lists "a written triage" among an unpinned

  the body, and `prepr.sh` step 7d accepted it. CI's `mutation` ratchet counts

Fix review: blocked 829ea7c7238d62293a58bb9d9625e844ac7fd09d carry-missing: not carried to R10-BRIEFS-FOLD

PR #2563, group R10-NIGHT-FOLDS, fix review (cloud reviewer seat). Head measured: 829ea7c7238d62293a58bb9d9625e844ac7fd09d (refs/pull/2563/head still points there when this was written). Merge base 3688cf25977ca71b4406be942df9592577d9b42e = origin/main. The diff to `dev/governance/roles/` between the merge base and origin/main is empty, so the contract is current. Detached worktrees: head /home/user/rev, base /home/user/base. Python is /opt/hpo/venv-ci (numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1).

## Blocking

Step 10, the forward-carry. The body's `## Forward-carry` line 1 (`Carry: R10-BRIEFS-FOLD`) records a finding this PR produced: the D2 step-5 class barrier "must drive the learners together: the gains arm needs a converged level and a genuine gain". That finding is real and changes the later stage:
- At this head, a gains probe driven at an unconverged level no longer measures anything. The sweep enumerator's own `probe_internal_gains` dies with `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable` (ev/enumerate.rev.out).
- The companion's `gains.converged` arm is the control that works (1.9800; ev/r10_night_folds_learners.rev.out).

So the precondition must reach the stage's brief before this PR merges (`finding-propagation.md`, Enforcement). It is not there:
- The body names `dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` as the destination but gives no `handoff/audit-r10-roster` SHA.
- At roster head 31e162fd3a1207db596539b2330af1d274c36c85, R10-BRIEFS-FOLD (stage not-started) has 20 carry entries and a brief. Its brief carries only the generic "D2 step 5 tests learners under error in the other covariate" (from the group brief, which predates this PR). No carry states the converged-level / genuine-gain precondition or its control (ev/roster_R10-BRIEFS-FOLD_at_31e162fd3.json).
- `git grep -i -E "converged level|genuine gain|drive the learners together"` over dev/programme, dev/governance and .claude/workflows finds nothing on the roster branch, on origin/main or at the head.

To clear it: append the carry to R10-BRIEFS-FOLD on `handoff/audit-r10-roster` (tools/audit/seat/roster_edit.py append-carry).
